title: Word Frequency
hints: Walk the text once, building the current word letter by letter; flush it into a std::unordered_map<std::string,int> when you hit a non-letter.
Copy the map into a std::vector<std::pair<std::string,int>> and std::sort it with a custom comparator.
Comparator: higher count first; on equal counts, the alphabetically smaller word first. Then resize the vector to at most k.
